data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in Australia, my top recommendation would be **Stripe**, unless you're already using Shopify — in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

The best option depends on your ecommerce platform, transaction volume and whether you're selling mainly in Australia or internationally.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Stripe Conversion Tracking – Able Customer Data Platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLblf37t9qmSgXH90IIrfyM1cEVlAyfeKTR0KIuJzNcMC_B2ZUJW9p7BftOV-yzXikVmn2jDYU_Zq1ExkRO0GTjHIMaYqcU4RzMNo1YrpDxk3GXGSNzey-FFdr644M2DVq4UsY3Zo9OE1wDfp2BQqWf9beRf_8lKhubJp-AjxGHf8Zwil7Ew0fyQc0BJ2PlA?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Easy integration with WooCommerce, Wix and custom websites.
- No standard monthly processing subscription.
- Supports cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and international payments.
- Good reporting and fraud prevention tools.

Australian domestic card pricing is around 1.65% + A\$0.30. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout and refunds.
- Less administrative work.
- Avoids additional third-party payment provider transaction fees.

Basic plan Australian online card pricing is around 1.75% + A\$0.30. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers.
- Useful as an additional checkout option.
- Easy to integrate with most ecommerce platforms.

Australian domestic commercial transaction pricing varies by checkout product. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Good if you sell online and in person.
- Integrates payments and inventory.
- Useful for small retailers and market stalls.

[Square Australia](https://squareup.com/au/en)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Airwallex**

- Particularly good for international sales.
- Multi-currency accounts and settlements.
- Competitive domestic card processing rates.

Australian domestic card pricing is around 1.65% + A\$0.30. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

## What I'd choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a small online store | Stripe |
| Already using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Selling internationally | Stripe or Airwallex |
| Selling online and at markets | Square |
| Want customers to pay using PayPal | Add PayPal alongside Stripe |


One important tip: don't necessarily choose the processor with the lowest advertised fee. Check international card fees, currency conversion, refunds, chargebacks and payout times too.
